rule_definition.oneSE: For each outer source, use winning candidate inner-source MAE standard error=std(per-sourceMAE,ddof1)/sqrt(G); accept selected family representatives with innerMAE<=winner+SE; mean them or choose first fixed simplicity order. No outer error informs eligibility.
rule_definition.soft: Weights=softmax(-(innerMAE-minMAE)/T), T fixed1 or2pp over8 family winners.
rule_definition.inverse: Weights proportional1/(innerMAE+.25pp) over8 family winners. No outer weights learned.
rule_definition.candidate16_equal: Equal mean all16 archived candidate predictions; no candidate eliminated.
rule_definition.near4_median: Median RF/GPR/XGB-early andRF-static selected in prior inner folds.

scientific_status: New prespecified analysis rules on already exposed development sources. Model predictions reused, not new prospective confirmation. Keep original third-round primary/results intact. No highest-score replacement of this primary.
inputs: Same six approved early summaries and optional static values, windows/minimum3 unchanged.
A_and_2E: Historical A/2E results retained; no corresponding new inner prediction archive or new data in this batch, no false new fits.
stop: Exactly9 finite rules x2 unchanged cohorts. No outcome-driven rules added.
